newsitem.title: USA: Ingersoll-Rand buys into Newman Tonks.
newsitem.headline: Ingersoll-Rand buys into Newman Tonks.

text.p: Ingersoll-Rand Co said Thursday that it had acquired more than 85 percent of the shares of Newman Tonks Group Plc, a British producer of architectural hardware.
The acquisition values Newman Tonks at about 230 million sterling, Ingersoll-Rand said.

Ingersoll-Rand, which had announced its offer to buy Newman Tonks January 27, said in a release that the combination "creates significant growth opportunities for Ingersoll-Rand's architectural hardware business."

Newman Tonks, headquartered in Birmingham, England, makes and supplies branded architectural products for the building industry. Ingersoll-Rand said the company had 1996 sales of about 259 million sterling and about 4,000 employees worldwide.
